agency: Department of Housing and Urban Development
summary: HUD explained that discussion of 'Type B' BREAKTHROUGH research projects, including the study on Mexican-American housing requirements, was deleted from the statement as inappropriate to its purpose, noting the study arose from a specific competition proposal.
text: Response: Discussion of this and other "Type B" BREAKTHROUGH research projects has been deleted from this statement as inappropriate to its purpose. The study in question was undertaken in response to one specific proposal received in that part of the BREAKTHROUGH competition.
